opt_in_request:
📢 **Welcome to Alayon Assistant, [name]!** Stay updated with voter services, emergency help & alerts. To subscribe, reply: **ALAYON YES**. To decline, reply: **ALAYON NO**.

📍 Example: Text **ALAYON YES** to subscribe.
subscription_confirmation: ✅ **Hello [name], your subscription is confirmed!** You’ll now receive voter info, emergency hotlines & community updates. Your phone number: [phone]. You can unsubscribe anytime by replying **ALAYON STOP**.
help:
📌 **Alayon Services:**
1️⃣ **ALAYON ASSIST** – Info & Help.
2️⃣ **ALAYON PRECINCT** – Voter details.
3️⃣ **ALAYON HOTLINE** – Emergency contacts.

📍 Example: Text **ALAYON HOTLINE** to get emergency numbers.
request_name:
📌 To complete your profile, reply with your details: **LAST NAME, FIRST NAME, MIDDLE NAME, BARANGAY, MUNICIPALITY**.

📍 Example: **ALAYON INFO Dela Cruz, Juan, Santos, Brgy 1, Tacloban City.**
opt_out_confirmation: ❌ You have unsubscribed from Alayon Assistant. To re-subscribe, reply **ALAYON YES**.
default: ⚠️ Sorry, we couldn't recognize your request. Try texting **ALAYON HELP** for available services.
